Class LokiGatewayProperties

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.gateway.loki.LokiGatewayProperties
@ConfigurationProperties("sca4dj.gateway.logging") public class LokiGatewayProperties extends Object
保存可选 Loki 写入代理的入口、目标地址和独立凭据。
